from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document with its identified cause category."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document, e.g. '《判决文书1》'")
    cause_category: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause category this document corresponds to, as extracted from the text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
